question: Will 'Joker 2' gross most in 2024?
vault_gap: Entertainment/box office coverage completely absent from vault.
rationale: Joker 2 was released October 4, 2024 — nearly 3 months after the cutoff. Inside Out 2 had already grossed $1B+ by July 15. Even if Joker 2 performed well (it didn't — it was a box office bomb grossing ~$200M), it couldn't catch Inside Out 2's head start. The question is essentially asking whether an unreleased October film will outgross a film that already earned $1B+.
